title: Library Book Checkout System
statement: Library Book Checkout System: Create a library book checkout system in C++ utilizing loops to manage the library's collection of books. Requirements: 1. Operate with a collection of 10 books, each identified by a unique ID (1 to 10). 2. Utilize arrays and loops to manage book information (IDs, titles, availability). 3. Write functions to display available books and check out books by entering their IDs. 4. Display a menu using a loop to continuously prompt users for choices until they decide to exit. 5. Ensure appropriate error handling within loops for invalid inputs (non-existent book IDs or already checked-out books).
expectedOutput:
Welcome to the Library Book Checkout System!
Menu:
1. Display available books
2. Check out a book
3. Exit
Enter your choice: 1
Available Books:
ID: 1, Title: "Book A", Available: Yes
ID: 2, Title: "Book B", Available: Yes
Enter your choice: 2
Enter the ID of the book you want to check out: 1
Book with ID 1 has been checked out successfully.
Enter your choice: 1
Available Books:
ID: 2, Title: "Book B", Available: Yes
Enter your choice: 3
Exiting the program. Thank you!

title: Conditional Logic Refactoring without Logical Operators
statement:
Rewrite/fill the empty if-else-if code skeletons for two given conditional expressions without using logical operators (&& and ||):
Snippet 1: if (a > b || !b >= c || a != c && c <= b)
Snippet 2: if (a > b || !b == c && a != c || c <= b)

title: Automated Quiz Grader with File I/O
statement: A teacher needs help marking a 20-question True/False quiz for 50 students. Student Roll Nos and answers (T, F, or space for unattempted) are stored in 'submission.txt', and the answer key is in 'solution.txt'. Each correct answer gives 1 mark with no negative marking. Write C++ code to read data from both files, calculate each student's score, and write the student's Roll_No alongside their marks into 'marks.txt'.
